description:

runs.result_output:
Done. Added 3 test cases for nested `for-binding` to `BindingTests.cs`:

1. **`NestedForBinding_TwoLevels`** — 2-level nesting, verifies element counts and content
2. **`NestedForBinding_ThreeLevels`** — 3-level nesting (`row > cell > val`)
3. **`NestedForBinding_OuterVariableAccessibleInInner`** — confirms outer loop variables are accessible inside inner loop templates

All 95 tests pass (92 original + 3 new). The existing `Binder.cs` implementation handles nested scoping correctly via `vm.CreateContext(ctx, dict)` — no code changes were needed.
